newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher on retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed higher as majority of the scrips gained marginally on Wednesday after a long bear-run, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 5.21 points or 0.55 percent to 949.78 on a turnover of 36.4 million taka. Gainers led losers by 74 to 51.
"The retail investors showed interest in many shares that reached virtually the bottom of their price level. These shares became attractive to them pricewise," one broker said.
Brokers said the scrips in engineering, cement and leather sectors gained substantially after dropping heavily in several past sessions.
Singer Bangladesh gained 60.97 taka to 5,004, Amam Sea Food Industries rose 62.41 to 3,352 and Chittagong Cement Clinker was up 31.70 to 1,456.

Chic Textile was the day's leader in terms of volume trading 24,500 shares that gained 0.14 taka to 11.09, followed by Beximco Pharmaceuticals selling 24,400 that lost 0.37 to 116.13. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
